diagnostic_and_fix_steps: Isolate electrical power and fuel/water supplies to the Hisense Portable & Window Inverter AC before servicing; discharge stored capacitor energy and test main terminals with your Digital Capacitance Multimeter.
Remove the primary access housing using hand tools to visually inspect the Compressor Motor Phase Harness (OEM #HAR-125) and wiring harness for heat discoloration, oxidation, or mechanical play.

Perform an electrical diagnostic check on the Compressor Motor Phase Harness terminals using your Digital Capacitance Multimeter; verify readings against the OEM specification (Winding Resistance: 15–35 Ω across terminals; infinite Ω (> 5M Ω) to ground).
If resistance is out of spec or mechanical damage is present, unmount the old assembly and install the certified replacement Compressor Motor Phase Harness (OEM #HAR-125).
Reassemble the chassis securely, restore power, clear diagnostic error memory, and run a full diagnostic test cycle to verify error CH21 is resolved.
